summary: Rebuild the plugin installer and manager acquisition tools with the fixed Go x/net module.
userImpact: Plugin acquisition and signature verification retain their existing interfaces.

instructions: Adopt the qualified installer and manager images when they are published.

security: Pin golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0 in both acquisition tool builds to address CVE-2026-78661. Update the minimum x/crypto and x/text versions required by that module.

customerDocumentation.reason: This embedded toolchain dependency update requires no customer configuration or procedure change.

knownLimitations: Exact image and cross-architecture qualification remain required before publication.
rollback: Prefer the next qualified forward build. Older image digests carry the affected module.
validation: Both native Linux ARM64 images build with emitted Cosign binaries reporting the fixed x/net module.
Local Trivy HIGH and CRITICAL scans pass for the rebuilt installer and manager images. The protected image and cross-architecture checks remain required.
